title: Absolutely loved it!
text: We tried a self-guided tour for the first time and absolutely loved it! The interactive challenges made exploring the city even more fun, and it was a great way to test how much (or how little!) we knew about the places we visited. And yes – we completed the skull challenge! the skull challenge!
author: Raminta_D

title: Really enjoyed it
text: I love traveling solo and avoiding tour groups, so this tour was perfect for me. It included plenty of hidden spots that most tourists miss, along with lots of essential information about the Barri Gotic. I took a longer break and returned to the game later -so the skull part didn’t work out too well for me.
author: Domas_G

title: Great tour!
text: I’ve been to Barcelona before, but this tour made me see the Gothic quarter in a whole new way. Loved exploring hidden gems and quiet little squares without the usual tourist crowds. It felt like discovering a secret side of the city. Plus, it’s super convenient – no need to download another app, everything works easily through Whatsapp. Totally recommend!
author: Raimonda_B

title: Thank you so much
text: Thank you so much for the recommendations – I found the best tapas bar and rooftop terrace! The tour itself was insightful, full of facts I didn’t know. Now, walking those streets, I feel a completely different connection to Barcelona

title: Great family adventure!
text: A really fun and easy tour! We did it with kids, and everyone enjoyed it. The tasks were interesting and made us pay attention to details. The best part was that we didn’t need to download any extra apps – everything worked on WhatsApp. There were lots of audio guides, pictures, and stories. And the coolest thing - we actually walked the skull shape! Super fun experience!
